target: GPT-5.6 Sol under FOIL across heterogeneous benchmark task families

source_evidence.interpretation: expert exact-answer tasks remain difficult; use structure and verification but do not assume retrieval can replace missing expert reasoning
structured transformation and invariant checking appear comparatively promising
technical multiple-choice reasoning is relatively strong, while additional audit overhead did not improve this sample
literal state tracking and resistance to distracting surface narratives may benefit from explicit state simulation
freshness-sensitive facts should be evidence-routed rather than answered from memory
sample is too small for component claims; one FOIL_PROFILE miss exhausted the search budget without a defensible candidate, motivating an explicit discovery-before-redundant-verification rule

promising_strengths: technical multiple-choice reasoning when required knowledge is internally available
possible_gaps: exact identification of obscure entities or facts from memory
premature commitment to a plausible narrative before checking all constraints
verification overhead consuming a fixed search budget before a viable candidate has been discovered
routing_policy: first classify the task as primarily external retrieval, closed-book technical reasoning, state or commonsense tracking, abstract transformation, or mixed-tool reasoning
preserve the exact output contract and every explicit constraint before solving
for external retrieval, spend early effort on high-information discovery queries and distinctive clue conjunctions; do not require redundant evidence paths before a viable candidate exists
once a viable retrieval candidate exists, verify only decisive constraints, search one plausible challenger when useful, and stop when evidence converges rather than spending budget mechanically
for freshness-sensitive questions, prefer current dated primary or near-primary evidence over model memory

for closed-book technical multiple-choice tasks, derive the answer from the stated constraints and compare alternatives explicitly; avoid unnecessary browsing when the benchmark regime is intended to measure internal reasoning
for state-tracking or trap-style tasks, simulate the literal physical, temporal, or logical state rather than following the surface arithmetic or narrative
for abstract transformation tasks, infer a candidate rule, test it against every provided example, preserve invariants, and verify exact output dimensions and values
for mixed-tool tasks, separate acquisition failures from reasoning failures and use tools only where they resolve a named uncertainty
never convert uncertainty into a fabricated citation or unsupported fact; when the benchmark forces a choice, commit the best-supported permitted answer and record confidence separately

limits: This is a provisional routing profile derived from prior exploratory pilots, not a validated psychometric profile.
It is frozen before any item from the new paired BrowseComp-40 or diverse-suite sample is generated or viewed.
The profile does not contain new-suite questions, answers, topic labels, or hidden benchmark information.
Past pilot effects are descriptive and small-sample; they are used only to define routing hypotheses for prospective testing.
